errors.text: The proposed critical threshold of approximately 500 K conflicts with the observed transition near 900 K.
The mechanism substitutes speculative SRO-controlled screw-dislocation, TWIP, and TRIP behavior for the target transition from stacking-fault-mediated plasticity to rapid lattice disorder.
The supporting evidence comes from compositionally and structurally different alloys and does not establish SRO, screw-dislocation control, or a 500 K threshold in FeNiCrCoCu.
The falsification experiment ends at 800 K and therefore cannot detect the actual instability beginning around 900 K.
